public_input.query: I'm a music journalist coming to London for a low-key birthday weekend with my partner. We're staying with friends in Hackney and don't want to spend the whole weekend commuting across town. We want quiet catch-up meals rather than loud party spots, and we'd prefer daytime-friendly places over clubby adults-only venues. I'd love at least one stop that connects to old houses or neighbourhood history. Since we cover live music for work, we don't want every daytime stop to be a museum either.
